interpretation.approximate_state: HF and CISD coefficient estimates can fail badly for cancellation-defined optimized-PF coefficients even when energies or overlaps look good.
interpretation.decision: Use response for the mixing correction and freeze the exact-a4 two-point fit as the next holdout candidate; retain direct finite-time validation.
interpretation.direct_fit: The exact-a4 two-point and free five-point high-tail fits pass all eight development conditions, but require frozen unused-system validation.
interpretation.response: Projected response exactly reproduces the F02 D4 state-mixing mechanism when the exact state is used.
